steps.name: Raise purchase requisition
steps.description: Requester records a need and submits a draft requisition with quantity, cost centre and estimated value.

steps.name: Approve requisition
steps.description: Cost centre manager reviews the draft requisition against budget and approves or rejects it.

steps.name: Issue purchase order
steps.description: Procurement officer converts the approved requisition into a purchase order and sends it to the supplier.

steps.name: Match and post supplier invoice
steps.description: Accounts payable clerk matches the supplier invoice to the purchase order and goods receipt note, then posts the payable.

requirements.statement: Every purchase order shall be supported by an approved requisition.
No supplier invoice shall be posted without a match against the purchase order and the goods receipt note.
Requisition approval and invoice posting shall not be performed by the same actor.
A purchase order shall not be issued before the requisition has been approved.
